observations: A used automatic transmission housing with a metal casing.
The exterior surface shows significant signs of rust and dirt.
A metal plate is visible on the side of the housing, but the text is illegible.
The housing is resting on a gravel or dirt surface.
A black plastic shroud or cover is attached to the side of the housing.

claims.evidence: No Toyota logo or model badge is visible in the photo.
No year marking is visible on the housing in the photo.
The item is clearly an automatic transmission housing.
No 2WD designation is visible on the housing in the photo.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The transmission may be seized, stripped, or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears or a clear photo of the output shaft and input shaft.

risks.risk: The metal plate on the side may be a different part or a stamped part of the same unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the metal plate with the text legible.

risks.risk: The housing may be a rebuilt or used part rather than a new original unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's part number stamped on the housing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the metal plate on the side of the housing.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears.
Photo of the output shaft and input shaft to check for wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
